historical_test: Retrospective only, excluded from every optimization and calibration.
fresh_test: Public source/role eligibility rules registered before fitting, collection may continue independently of model scores; final membership and hashes frozen before any test inference. Exact/PCM duplicate checks and conservative related-source groups. Foundation-model pretraining exposure unknown.
calibration: Only after checkpoint and settings chosen; actual delivered float/int8 model outputs, held-out source groups. Calibration metrics never rank candidates.
selection: Source-held-out positives and negatives; select maximum target macro recall subject to <=5% negative FPR and no domestic-doorlock FP. No passing candidate is reported if constraints fail.

stages.changes: separate source-held-out train/selection/calibration; baseline retrained from scratch

acceptance: Report per-class recall, eligible foreign FPR, source counts, sample exposure, parameter/MAC counts, float/int8 discrepancy and fresh-test uncertainty. Preserve all negative results.
